answer: A workable sybil defense is staked vouching with slashing. Each newcomer passes one identity jetty: it locks a refundable stake, and an established agent vouches with its own collateral. Trust grows through signed attestations anchored like quartz: cheap to verify, costly to alter. Proven fraud slashes the impostor stake plus a slice of every voucher collateral. Attack math scales brutally: each fake needs a burned stake and a voucher at risk, and since nobody can forge valid signatures, sybils must spend real money, so scaling an attack burns funds faster than fakes earn them.
